title: AAPS errors in propagated data
body:
I use GDH for it's watchface, Android Auto and screen widget. There are discrepancies between what AAPS shows and what GDH shows. GDH gets data from AAPS only, from Citizen watch export line.

Not sure of related, I use last dev v4

This is what GDH received. Check the 2nd entry
